implementation: Candidate-only histogram, single-CTA prefix and scatter group unchanged selected cell IDs by one of three weight-row/token-window policies. Original36-byte prepared operands, staged2 four-lane dot, K16 ordering, candidate selection and output cell ownership are unchanged. Bucket order is deterministic; order within a bucket is unspecified. The isolated launch validates shape, spans and nonoverlap before mutation. Invalid device IDs set status and suppress scatter. Uniqueness is an explicit caller precondition and is established for each complete test input. Every GPU completion is bounded.
correctness_scope: Each warmup and measured attempt compares every raw output to the current staged2 control and every final BF16 output to the original GB10 operator reference. Complete candidate permutations, per-bin histograms and cursors, every prepared operand word, original inputs, output guards and unused workspace tails are checked. QKV and OUT preserve7169 captured rows and repeat1023 input rows to reach8192. The OUT reference was separately generated by GB10 at that full shape. References are comparison data only. Neither shape is a new end-to-end prompt or token loop.
timing_scope: One warmup plus three measured attempts per variant with rotating variant order. Completed host timers include full weight/input encoding, histogram, prefix, scatter and replay in launches of at most262144 candidates. Original matrix producer and candidate selection are common setup outside these component timers; so are allocation, resets and validation. All guarded process walls are attached. No startup, model TTFT or token generation is measured.

decision.decision: Keep the component isolated. All complete raw and GB10 BF16 comparisons pass. QKV does not improve:42.5851ms current versus43.4219ms fastest bucket. OUT improves159.341ms to143.929ms with16 weight rows and256 token rows per bucket, including all preparation, histogram, prefix, scatter and replay. This15.412ms operator saving does not by itself establish a seconds-scale product improvement while TTFT remains about30s. Pure weight-major grouping regresses both shapes. Preserve the exact ordering primitive for reuse within a broader reduction of replay work; no runtime dispatch or new real-model measurement is claimed.
